blocks.text: Filipino Eyekons have something to look forward to in 2027 as global girl group Katseye is set to return to the Philippines for their ‘The Wildworld Tour.” The group announced the Asia, Australia, and New Zealand legs of their tour through its social media pages on Thursday, Oct. 29. Their Philippine shows are set for Jan. 29 at the SM Mall of Asia Arena in Manila, and Feb. 7 at SM Seaside Cebu Arena in Cebu. “We can’t wait to see even more of our EYEKONS in 2027!” the group said.
